summary: Thinking and speech support drive and anger. This cooperative pattern asks you to use clear thinking and courage with awareness.
body: Thinking and speech support drive and anger. This cooperative pattern asks you to use clear thinking and courage with awareness. Quick, incisive thinking and confident argument. The connection is available when you choose to use it; it works best through deliberate practice. In practice, this can show up through thinking and speech, drive and anger, and the choices you make when mental noise or reactivity starts running the room.
gift: The gift is clear thinking, courage, and a more conscious way to work with thinking and speech and drive and anger.
shadow: The shadow is mental noise, reactivity, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let thinking and speech and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Fast, cutting thinking; the task is channeling the edge productively.
do: Name how thinking and speech and drive and anger are both involved
Turn clear thinking and courage into one concrete choice
dont: Let mental noise make the decision
Ignore the needs of thinking and speech or drive and anger
